06-5.solution: Together for 3 days they do \(3\left(\frac{1}{15} + \frac{1}{10}\right) = \frac{1}{2}\). Alternating, each pair of days does \(\frac{1}{6}\), so the other half takes 3 pairs: \(6\) days.

06-7.solution: Each pair of days (Q then P) does \(\frac{1}{36} + \frac{1}{24} = \frac{5}{72}\). After 14 pairs (28 days) \(\frac{70}{72}\) is done; on day 29 Q does the last \(\frac{2}{72}\) exactly, so the work takes \(29\) days.

06-14.solution: Each pair of days does \(\frac{1}{18} + \frac{1}{15} = \frac{11}{90}\). After 16 days \(\frac{88}{90}\) is done; on day 17 P needs only \(\frac{2}{90}\) of its \(\frac{5}{90}\), so the job ends during the 17th day.

06-22.solution: Together for 4 days: \(4\left(\frac{1}{10} + \frac{1}{15}\right) = \frac{2}{3}\). B alone for 2 days adds \(\frac{2}{15}\), so \(\frac{1}{5}\) is left. Alternating from B: day 1 leaves \(\frac{2}{15}\), on day 2 A leaves \(\frac{1}{30}\), and B needs half of day 3: \(2.5\) days.
